name: AnikkuNX
subtitle: Anime streaming with a Crunchyroll-style interface

apps.name: Ciname
apps.subtitle: Anikku and Cinejoy in one app
apps.localizedDescription: Opens on a picker: Anikku for anime, Cinejoy for movies and TV. Each keeps your place; the back button on either app's Home, or a swipe in from the left edge, returns to the picker. Pop-ups and ad domains are blocked. iPhone and iPad, iOS 15+.

apps.name: Anikku
apps.subtitle: Anime with a slick, ad-free player
apps.localizedDescription: Crunchyroll-style anime app: trending and seasonal rows, series pages with episode stills, My List, history and a weekly schedule. Anikku's own player controls with skip intro/outro and autoplay; pop-ups, new tabs and ad scripts are blocked. iPhone and iPad, iOS 15+.

apps.name: AnikkuNX
apps.subtitle: Anime streaming, Crunchyroll style
apps.localizedDescription: Browse and stream anime from English sources with a Crunchyroll-style home, series pages with episode stills, My List, history and offline downloads. Landscape, iPhone and iPad (iOS 15+).
